findings.description: The elm site has workers-17 (2 replicas) still querying SELECT id, legacy_format FROM deliveries. Dropping the column will cause query failures at that site while those workers are still running.
findings.reasoning: Review identifies the exact workers-17 query at elm, explains the column-drop impact, and notes cedar is unaffected.

findings.description: The migration should wait until all workers referencing legacy_format are upgraded past workers-17.
findings.reasoning: Review provides three concrete mitigation options: upgrade workers first, add pre-migration check, or use expand-and-contract pattern.
